_comment: Draft Alexa+ MCP add-on manifest for Plot Speaks. Field names follow Amazon's add-on documentation as read on 2026-10-21; the alexa-ai CLI that validates and deploys it is in an invitation-only preview, so this file is unvalidated. See docs/alexa/README.md.

en-US.name: Plot Speaks
en-US.shortDescription: Murder mysteries, trivia and story games you play out loud. Alexa narrates; Plot Speaks keeps the answers.
en-US.description:
Bring your own AI, and a library of games to play with it. Plot Speaks is a library of murder mysteries, choose-your-path adventures, trivia boards, party games, open worlds and quiet wind-downs that Alexa plays with you by voice. Alexa is the narrator and the host; the Plot Speaks server keeps every answer key, rules on every accusation and every trivia answer, and gives up exactly one line at a time, only when you have earned it.

Mysteries: question suspects, search rooms, then accuse. The server rules with a single line and reveals the solution only after a correct accusation or when you give up. Trivia: ten general boards, Team Trivia for 356 teams with today's roster, a daily board everyone plays with the same deal, quick fire, streak, and "I've got ten minutes" sizing. Challenge a ruling and three independent judges decide. Games: Werewolf, Twenty Questions, open worlds that remember you, and wind-downs for the end of the day.

Sign in with Google once and your progress, ratings and badges are kept. A second screen can follow a trivia game at plotspeaks.com/watch. Anyone can write and submit a story by voice; submissions are screened and reviewed before they are listed. Stories are free.
examplePhrases: Alexa, start The Last Toast with Plot Speaks.
Alexa, play today's trivia board on Plot Speaks.
Alexa, play a wind-down from Plot Speaks.
